context.guidance: Record the destination of each outbound transfer of Personal Data, and check it against any restriction the Central Government has notified under §16(1). Rule 15 governs data made available to foreign States, and Rule 13(4) applies where a Significant Data Fiduciary is involved. Send any flow whose destination is not restricted to legal review, and state the destination in the notice.

value.fix: The default aws_region of eu-west-1 (Ireland) makes this a potential outbound transfer of Personal Data unless the deployed resources hold no personal data. Before relying on it, (1) inventory which resources in this region store or process personal data and record eu-west-1 as the destination for each flow; (2) check each destination against any restriction the Central Government has notified under §16(1); (3) if the destination is not restricted, send the flow to legal review, applying Rule 15 if data is made available to a foreign State and Rule 13(4) if a Significant Data Fiduciary is involved; (4) state the destination (eu-west-1, Ireland) in the privacy notice; (5) if legal review cannot confirm the transfer is permitted, or the data does not need to leave India, change the default to an in-country region such as ap-south-1 (Mumbai) and make the region an explicit, reviewed input rather than a silent default.
